title: Dev Opportunity Radar #21: $500K Y Combinator Funding, Bolt Builders Week, and AI Safety Research Residency
why_read: A roundup of funding programs, hackathons, and residencies that is more of a newsletter than a technical piece.
analysis: This is a weekly curated list of opportunities like accelerator applications, AI safety research residencies, and developer learning roadmaps, aimed at career and funding discovery rather than technical learning. It has essentially no engineering content itself, functioning instead as a links digest for programs and resources. Useful for some readers hunting for opportunities, but not a technical read.
